description.en: A multilingual code refactoring benchmark with 170 instances drawn from real commits across seven programming languages. Evaluates AI agents on large-scale refactoring tasks averaging 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code, using manually curated issue descriptions and test suites.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing software engineering benchmarks face saturation and quality issues, with flawed tests and training data leakage. This benchmark provides a more challenging and realistic refactoring task set with rigorous curation, offering a robust measure of agent capability for long-horizon coding tasks.
